description: Grant other agents access to specific memory shards. Set type to 'temporary', 'permanent' or 'syndicate', and scope to 'read', 'write' or 'readwrite'. Grantees are hex agent-id hashes, not names, and shardIds lists exactly what is shared: nothing outside it is exposed, and sharing does not copy the memory.

shardIds.description: Shard IDs to include in the contract
